_about: S8 (pre-integration audit): versioned calibration baseline — the single source of the minimum scientific recovery ARIA must keep. The recovery benchmarks (synthetic ground-truth DE/DA) already compute recall + empirical FDR; this file pins the floor/ceiling so a refactor that degrades recall or inflates empirical FDR fails the build instead of silently passing. aria/benchmarks/calibration.check_calibration compares a benchmark's metrics against its entry here. Tighten a bound only with a deliberate commit + rationale.

synthetic_de_pseudobulk.provenance: Synthetic ground-truth pseudobulk DE. Validated recovery is recall 1.0 / empirical FDR 0.0 (docs/validation_status.md); the floor/ceiling here are the regression bounds the heavy lane already asserted.

scatac_pseudobulk_da.provenance: Synthetic ground-truth scATAC pseudobulk DA (chromatin _pseudobulk_da -> _run_deseq2). Bounds match tests/test_benchmark_scatac_da.

bulk_atac_da.provenance: Synthetic ground-truth bulk ATAC DA (chromatin_bulk_diffacc technical-sample aggregation + replicate-gated _run_deseq2 + convergence gate). Validated recovery recall 0.667 / empirical FDR 0.0 (F12). Bounds match tests/test_benchmark_bulk_atac_da.
